notes.title: Welcome to Crew Wars
notes.content:
[p]We're launching a fun new Discord leaderboard that is based around player created crews. This is a test feature built for Discord only at the moment to encourage friendly Inter crew competition and collaboration.[/p][p][/p][p][b]How It works[/b]:[/p][p]At the end of each [b]HERO event[/b] in game, the top 10 scores are processed and each individual earns points for their crew based on their position.[/p][p][b]#1 – 100 pts, #2 – 75 pts, #3 – 60 pts, #4 – 50 pts, #5 – 40 pts, #6 – 35 pts, #7 – 30 pts, #8 – 25 pts, #9 – 20 pts, #10 – 15 pts[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The crew standings run for the whole month, and then the winning crew earns 1 WIN that is added to the total Crew Wins leaderboard that will be posted on the first day of each month.[/p][p]In each new month, the crew standings will reset, giving you a chance to recoup and get ready to compete again for the new month![/p][p]NOTE: The very first crew results will start to be posted as early as [b]TOMORROW[/b]. And we will complete a TEST for the rest of the month to ensure the system is working. We will iron out any bugs and will begin official crew leaderboards and wins at the start of August.[/p][p]
What you need to do:[/p][list][*][p]Simply adjust your game player name to this format:[b]\[CREW] Player Name[/b] so that the discord bot has an easy time picking it up. Example:[b]\[GMG] Billy Goat[/b].  You can do this from your account page at [url="http://torquemotorsport.io/"]torqueMotorsport.io[/url]  [/p][/*][*][p]Keep an eye on the new [url="https://discord.com/channels/968285871025586256/1394904129284866110"]Crew-War-Standings[/url] channel on our [url="https://discord.gg/torquemotorsport"]Discord[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Join the [url="https://discord.com/channels/968285871025586256/1179641041482158160"]Crews[/url] channel and look for a crew if you don't have one already[/p][/*][*][p]Compete in Hero Events![/p][/*][/list][p]At this stage we are keen to see how everyone likes this system, and if it's popular we will improve it and create a more integrated solution within the game itself. We are certainly looking for feedback so please let us know what you think![/p][p]Since this is a test feature, there may be bugs so let us know and we will endeavour to resolve them asap to ensure accurate standings and fair competition.[/p][p]Above everything else, have fun![/p]

notes.title: Update 0.14.1 Hotfix Release Notes
notes.content:
[p]Hotfix 0.14.1 brings a number of improvements plus some extra content following feedback from our last major update 0.14.
We hope you are enjoying all the new content in Torque Drift 2, and as always please don’t hesitate to engage with us on the Discord so we can continue making the game the best it can be![/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]Torque Motorsport brand decal logos [/p][/*][*][p]New Font Decal Packs[/p][/*][*][p]New Neo Tribal Decal Pack[/p][/*][*][p]Added VRAM diagnostics button in visual settings[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265186/b42b457282e28b9a91dff0fc990014ff01c63b41.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265186/f122598b4dc11098493ba12ba1465a291cc7922d.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265186/b8e7ae0bd9ada13011814342a9df321c24eabc1d.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Spoiler struts sometimes not being constructed properly resulting in odd spoiler look[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a number of track surface and collision issues on Ebisu, AdamLZ Compound, Daikoku, Irwindale [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Materials being broken on Irwindale drag strip[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed STROM wheels from the Drift Games Bundle not appearing for users in the garage[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed drone camera lock on feature not working properly for lobbies set to Collision OFF[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed layers set to HIDDEN not appearing hidden when driving[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Uniform Scale also moving decal with keyboard[/p][/*][*][p]Throttle not working sometimes when first entering a lobby[/p][/*][*][p]Custom liveries appearing on newly purchased cars in the shop[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when opening photo library in drone mode in lobby[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed wheel size resetting when purchasing new items from tune menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with visual setting menu becoming glitched under certain conditions[/p][/*][*][p]Decal icon image being squashed in paintshop layer UI[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several missing/incorrect button guide UI items in paintshop for controller and keyboard[/p][/*][*][p]Added tune range for Enkie RPF1 wheels[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug in chase events where it would count as a tandem when not within proximity[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Race steering improved for low speed turning and overall control[/p][/*][*][p]Added controller understeer assist slider and input sensitivity slider in settings[/p][/*][*][p]Added Controller sensitivity slider within controls setting[/p][/*][*][p]Shifted Hero events to the Singleplayer menu item instead of within Drift, we have also started including race events in the rotation[/p][/*][*][p]Installing a part after purchase now installs on all available slots for that part, for example installing a new set of wheels installs front and back instead of just the side you purchased on.[/p][/*][*][p]Third person camera #1 increased sense of braking force[/p][/*][*][p]Third person camera #1 added vertical height while in tandem to allow for more fine control over tandem distance, this is also tunable in the camera settings under “Added Tandem Pitch”[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted smoke amount per tire and adjusted smoke quality setting to make more noticeable adjustments for finer control[/p][/*][*][p]The Creators, Basic shapes and Curves decal bundles are now owned by default.[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial Dialog for events now only shows on first entry and not every retry[/p][/*][*][p]Added failure panel with more information if accepting [u][url="http://mod.io"]Mod.io[/url][/u] terms and conditions fails[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265186/05f77a075e6d47bf9eab2de79b55aee8a92de5a2.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ve made some adjustments to the car part customisation wireframe for a better user experience, including adding the tires node to the performance section.[/p][list][*][p]Moved tire node to also be included in the performance part wireframe[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted some of the view angles and distances for Wheel and lug nuts[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted some of the part wireframe connections so you don't get stuck[/p][/*][*][p]Made the Engine node reference the bonnet so you can get from suspension to engine [/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the Rollcage camera angle so it’s not looking down when selected[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the 180sx TypeX, TypeX Aero, Sil80 and SR20 tire profiles not being able to be tuned[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 0.14 - Performance and physics overhaul
notes.content:
[h1]PAINTSHOP[/h1]
Our biggest new and highly requested feature is the livery editor! Manipulate and customise your car's appearance using a thoroughly designed system with the user's experience in mind.
The following options are available to you:
[list]
[*]Livery slots, allowing you to create many different designs for the one car
[/list]
Decal actions Basic
[list]
[*] Place
[*] Stamp
[*] Move
[*] Rotate
[*] Mirror & mirror flip
[*] Uniform scale
[*] Orthographic camera
[*] Toggle camera snap (Snap camera rotation to closest side)
[*] Fine movement control toggle (Slow movement of Scale, Rotate, Skew and Move actions)
[/list]
Decal actions Advanced (Toggle on with caps on keyboard and Left trigger on controller)
[list]
[*] Non-Uniform scale
[*] Skew decal
[*] Horizontal and Vertical Flip
[/list]
Layer actions
[list]
[*] Mirror & Mirror flip mode
[*] Change color
[*] Replace decal
[*] Rename
[*] Hide/unhide
[*] Duplicate
[*] Reorder
[*] Delete
[*] Delete all
[/list]
There is also a brand new section in the shop where you can purchase decal packs to use on your cars.

We have big plans for future expansion of this feature, including decal creator, paint through decal action, layer groups and more so stay tuned for future updates

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265186/e8645078d239f2d8313d932c7186e04f8a606329.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265186/dcf068c0e6b9cde98803ee18000839a82929f1e9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265186/67d683f60bcc6c3183ea34f8de0e41e2e26cedef.png[/img]

[h1]PHYSICS UPDATES + NEW GAME MODE[/h1]

Major adjustments to the physics have been made to provide a more fun and engaging experience. 
We have been listening to all your feedback on our physics and have made several adjustments to allow for more feeling of weight, grip and better handling between grip and drift. We now have the ability to not only tune a car for drifting but also traditional racing as well.  
We have included the following additions to complete our physics adjustments.
Slick Tires 
Tune Defaults for Drift and Race
Major Sim Rig Force Feedback changes

New time trial game mode features 12 brand new layouts designed purely for traditional racing. 

[h1]PERFORMANCE[/h1]

We've implemented major optimizations across the game, resulting in an general performance increase of 15%, with some systems seeing even greater gains. Rendering settings, Materials, Meshes have all received large passes to reduce overhead, improving frame rates on lower-spec PCs. Performance should now be in line with other third-party titles built on Unreal Engine 5. Additionally Nanite Resolution Settings have been added to help you squeeze more out of your game Should you like to trade off some model detail for some performance. (this can be found in the advanced section of the graphics settings)

[h1]MULTIPLAYER IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]

Multiplayer has been a core focus for this update. We have reworked lobby input and removed input lag for clients. You can now play comfortably against your friends no matter where they are. We have also added the ability to turn off collisions when setting up multiplayer lobbies.

[h1]New Additions[/h1]

[h3]Cars[/h3]
[list]
[*] Drift Games RX-7 FD and Supra Mk5
[*] Adam LZ Pro E36
[*] Stock BMW E36
[*] Stock BMW G80
[*] Toyota GR Corolla
[*] Toyota GT 86
[*] Subaru BRZ 2012
[*] Nissan R33 400R (Level Unlock Only)
[*] Nissan 180sx Sileighty (Level Unlock Only)
[*] Nissan S15 Spec R Aero W/Kit (Level Unlock Only)
[*] Nissan R35 Nismo 2020 (Level Unlock Only)
[*] Nissan R34 Nismo S-Tune (Level Unlock Only)
[/list]

[h3]Parts[/h3]
[list]
[*] Street Hunter body kits for Toyota Supra Mk5
[*] Liberty walk Super Silhouette Mazda FD35 RX-7
[*] 1JZ and 1.5JZ engines
[*] Over 40 new Rotiform alloys
[*] Custom headlights
[*] 4pt and 6pt roll cages for all cars
[*] GMG Monkey bobblehead
[*] Gold Monkey bobblehead (Level Unlock Only)
[*] Gold Torque Motorsport Wheels (Level Unlock Only)
[*] Decal Packs
[/list]

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased player level cap to 100 with new rewards
[*] Custom camera settings 
[*] Control Remapping
[*] Drone mode lock on and follow features
[*] Settings defaults
[*] Vehicle thumbnails are now dynamic and display the vehicle's current color and livery.
[*] Irwindale has been expanded to include the 1/8th Mile drag strip, carpark area and burnout pad. The drag strip includes functional lights and time board. Find it in the back right corner of the map.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes/Optimisations/Changes[/h1]

[h3]Major[/h3] 
[list]
[*] Economy update, ToFu will now be much easier to earn and you will earn more per ToFu stage
[*] Streamlined garage main menu
[*] You can now purchase a duplicate part in the tuning menu by pressing “buy again” viewable in the bottom left button guide
[*] Chase run replay collisions vastly improved
[*] ABS (Anti-lock braking system) is now part of the tune menu and will change automatically based on changing the tune defaults
[*] Parts menu is now within the main secondary menu in the garage instead of within “Inventory”
[*] Improved part node cameras and positions for a smoother car customising experience
[/list]
[b]Chase game mode score changes[/b]
The Chase Game Mode scoring system has been overhauled to emphasize precision and realistic tandem drifting. Score multipliers based on drift states have been removed, and points are now awarded primarily for maintaining close proximity to the lead car. The threshold for achieving a “Tandem” drift has been tightened, requiring players to closely match the lead vehicle’s angle and direction. These changes raise the skill ceiling, encouraging tighter, more controlled chases and discouraging unrealistic drifting techniques.

[h3]Minor[/h3]
[list]
[*] Inventory menu now includes manufacturer filter
[*] The button guide now has new UI artwork
[*] Fixed Nissan 180sx Sileighty hood clipping
[*] Fixed up taillights on some cars so they appear less grainy
[*] Removed colored dots from tires
[*] Added milliseconds to timed event results
[*] Upgraded to DLSS 4 to support 5000 series 3X / 4X upscaling
[*] Pause menu time dilation has been removed
[*] Air con units on LZ Compound are now destructible 
[*] Tents in Irwindale can now be knocked over
[*] Fixed an issue where the R34 Ztune was missing side skirt
[*] Fixed an issue where controller throttle had an excessive deadzone
[*] Suspected fix for rare issue where vehicle suspension becomes broken in multiplayer lobbies
[*] Fixed a bug where your input sometimes doesn’t work in a multiplayer lobby
[*] Adjusted some camera angles in main garage menu
[*] Fixed various misplaced assets across different tracks
[/list]

notes.title: What we're working on!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi everybody![/h1]

Yes we're still here and working hard on our next release, update 0.14!
It's been a while so we thought we'd get you all up to speed on some of the stuff we've been up to!

[h2]The Big Things[/h2]

Performance! Performance! Performance! We heard you! We’ve made massive improvements across the game and are now seeing significantly better results across a range of PC's!

Next up on the list is a look into our physics! We have been listening to all your feedback on our physics and have made several adjustments to allow for more feeling of weight, grip and better handling between grip and drift. We now have the ability to not only tune a car for drifting but also traditional racing as well. So keep an eye out for more grip style modes in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265186/79eb23295a9eb603d125ce46121c9df7b7432b8b.png[/img]

Our biggest new and highly requested feature that will be releasing this coming update is the paintshop with livery editor! Get ready to make your car your own with a wide variety of decals to choose from!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265186/a51fcc8b527738ca607b4b3c45d485be8b6c8d46.png[/img]

We’ve also spent some time fixing the input lag issue across multiplayer lobbies! You will soon be able to enjoy playing with your friends from anywhere in the world lag free!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265186/dd57817e96f5835d95c1ab7c3e64e72d62fb29c7.png[/img]

[h2]Smaller Things [/h2]

- Economy Updates (MORE ToFu)
- Main Menu UI Streamlined
- Several new cars and parts
- Custom camera settings + updated drone
- Time Trial Game Mode
- Increase player level cap to 100 + new rewards
- Irwindale Expanded (including a functional drag strip)
- Controller Mapping
- Sim rig force feedback changes
- Tune menu defaults
- Much more!

We're so close to getting the update out the door for you all! Please bear with us while we iron out the bugs.

[b]Stay Sideways everyone! [/b]

notes.title: 0.13 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h3]Hero Events[/h3]
Until now, our EVENTS game mode featured a rotating list of Lead and Chase layouts with weekly leaderboards and rewards. For 0.13, we’re renaming this game mode to HERO EVENTS, and will now feature at least 3 events per week, all with leaderboards and increased rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265186/af4954c514146b73ed4b279f9dfc3c302f1b256c.png[/img]
[h3]Lead Events[/h3]
We all love a Lead Event!

In addition to Hero Events, we’re also introducing a new LEAD EVENTS game mode featuring all our current Lead layouts (48 and counting!), each with its own leaderboard so you can see where you place amongst the best. These leaderboards are lifetime and do not reset or include weekly rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265186/39dae925684135d50ddfe54c560dc39f435b1e87.png[/img]
[h3]Leaderboards Everywhere[/h3]
The title says it all! As of 0.13, every timed-game mode will now have a lifetime leaderboard, including Drift Skills and Freestyle! That's 90 leaderboards for you to compete in, plus the 3 weekly Hero Event leaderboards!

To tie it all together we are also introducing a new TOTAL POINT leaderboard, which combines all your leaderboard placement scores across all game modes (excluding Hero Events) into one giant leaderboard! Similar to Lead Events, the Total Point leaderboard does not reset or include weekly rewards.

Better get drifting if you want to get to the top!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265186/b7b9981cb4ea5967e0c8ad0ee6e8fc9554c1dc76.png[/img]
[h3]New Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Multiplayer now supports up to 8 players
[*] The Tutorial is now replayable from the Drifting menu
[*] Increased the amount of ToFu you get when levelling up
[*] Increased the amount of ToFu gained from Bundles
[*] Added a new starting panel on Lead and Freestyle events
[*] Daikoku is now available for Multiplayer Dedicated Servers
[*] Added a new Dedicated Server region in Germany
[/list]
[h3]Fixes/Optimisations/Changes
Major[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed various crashes across the game
[*] Fixed a major hitch that occurred when crossing the finish line in any game mode
[*] Fixed an issue causing your score to not submit properly at the end of an event
[*] Fixed an issue causing events not to finish when the player drives through a finish line
[*] Fixed an issue causing cars to spawn incorrectly in the Results Menu or when Restarting an event
[*] Fixed an issue allowing Spectators to spectate other Spectators
[/list]
[h3]Minor[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated the Ride Height tuning parameter to have a lower minimum range
[*] Ebisu: Fixed various environmental issues causing cars to get stuck
[*] Daikoku: Fixed a road collision issue affecting the Freestyle Intermediate event
[*] Shop: Fixed an issue causing cars to roll off the platform in the Expo
[*] Paintshop: Fixed an issue causing Glossiness not to update when using Recently Used colours
[*] Multiplayer: Fixed an issue causing Player Tags to not display in Drone Mode
[*] Multiplayer: Fixed an issue causing Spectator pings to not update in the Player List menu
[*] General Localisation fixes
[*] Various fixes to Menus and UI
[/list]
[h3]Known Issues

Multiplayer[/h3]
[list]
[*] The host of a P2P lobby can sometimes freeze or crash
[*] Issue causing long loading screen times when creating a new Dedicated Server
[*] Issue causing the AUTO region setting to always use Australian Dedicated Servers
[*] Players can experience instant errors when joining lobbies (restarting the game should fix this)
[*] The wheels on other players’ cars can load incorrectly, causing them to detach from the chassis (players with bugged cars can fix this by switching to Spectator and then back to Driver)
[*] Player name tags can load incorrectly and display in the wrong place above their car
[*] Issue causing the Music Player to not work in Dedicated Servers
[*] Brake lights are always on for clients in P2P lobbies
[*] The Lobby Menu does not refresh automatically after exiting a lobby
[*] Cars can sometimes spawn on top of each other in lobbies with more than 4 players
[/list]

[h3]MISC[/h3]
[list]
[*] Minor hitching can occur when entering the Drift Skills menu
[*] Minor visual issues with reflections on car mirrors
[*] Ebisu: Visual issue causing flickering on roads
[*] Shop: Rare issue causing the BUY button to be missing for the Mad Mike Mega Bundle (restarting the game should fix this)
[*] Languages: Some text in the game may not be translated
[*] Car liveries can appear blurry and take a while to load
[*] Minimaps incorrectly display for Mod Tracks
[/list]
